description: Videos The First Book can fetch for offline use. Only Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) videos belong here: scripts/fetch_videos.py re-checks each one's licence on YouTube before downloading and refuses anything else. The app itself never goes online; the files live in library/videos/ and are not in git. Credit each creator with the attribution line (the watch page shows it).
